title: RFID Livestock Leg Band — USDA NPIP / EU 2019/2035 / ICAR Section 5 Dairy / CITES Raptor / Pigeon-Racing ISO 11784 Poultry & Dairy Leg-Band RFID
summary: RFID livestock leg bands snap around the tarsus of poultry, waterfowl, pigeons, raptors and psittacines — and the pastern of dairy cows, sheep, and goats. Binding a GS1 / ICAR / national-animal-ID / CITES / USBGA / PIPA identifier to every layer hen, broiler breeder, turkey breeder, duck / goose breeder, Bantam show bird, AKC-registered raptor, CITES Appendix I/II psittacine, racing pigeon, and dairy-parlor milking cow; so USDA NPIP inspectors, EU TRACES NT veterinary authorities, USFWS migratory-bird banding offices, CITES Management Authority export-certificate officials, pigeon-racing-club clocking tellers, and dairy-parlor herd-management software surface the record with a LF ISO 11784/11785 HDX / FDX-B transceiver or a UHF RAIN portal — publishing EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents to USDA APHIS NPIP Information System + EU Animal Disease Information System (ADIS) + USGS Bird Banding Laboratory (BBL) + CITES Trade Database + PIPA / USBGA / AU pigeon-racing clocks + DairyComp 305 / DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / AfiFarm / NEDAP CowControl herd-management instead of hand-closed aluminium band + paper breeding-book + manual clock-pad records.
keywords: CITES Appendix I / II raptor + psittacine breeding
USBGA + PIPA + FCI pigeon racing ISO 11784
heroPoints: USDA NPIP 9 CFR 145-147 + EU 2019/2035 + EU 1308/2013 + CITES Appendix I/II + USBGA + PIPA + FCI + ICAR-fit per-bird / per-cow identifier — every layer hen, broiler breeder, turkey breeder, AKC-registered raptor, CITES-listed psittacine, racing pigeon and dairy-parlor cow carries an ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B or HDX 15-digit country + species + unique-ID record binding hatch / calving date, breeder band number, genomic-parentage (Aviagen / Cobb / Hy-Line / Lohmann / Nick Chick / Novogen / ISA / Shaver / Hubbard / CITES-registered breeder; Zoetis GeneSeek GGP / Neogen Igenity for dairy), vaccination lot (Marek / IBDV Gumboro / NDV Newcastle / ILT / AIV avian-influenza H5/H7 / IBV bronchitis / MG mycoplasma / SE salmonella for poultry; RB51 brucellosis / BVD / IBR / Clostridium for dairy), USDA NPIP clean-flock status, USFWS bird-banding BBL number, CITES Management Authority permit number, and pigeon-racing USBGA / PIPA club-band serial to the fastener tarsus / pastern serial.

LF ISO 11784/11785 HDX / FDX-B + UHF RAIN Gen2v2 dual-frequency architecture — LF (134.2 kHz) handheld / panel reads satisfy USDA NPIP + USFWS BBL + CITES + USBGA / PIPA / FCI regulatory presentation at hatchery + breeder barn + export-quarantine + pigeon-racing loft clocking + dairy milking parlor; UHF (860-960 MHz) portal reads enable layer-barn walk-through + broiler-breeder sort-gate + dairy sort-gate + bulk-tank pick-up 600-1,000+ bird / cow per-hour throughput — both frequencies produced as EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents published to USDA APHIS NPIP Information System + USGS BBL + CITES Trade Database + pigeon-racing club clocks + ICAR + Interbull genetic-evaluation + DairyComp 305 / DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / AfiFarm / NEDAP CowControl platforms instead of hand-closed aluminium band + paper breeding-book + manual clock-pad.

Snap-on TPU / Santoprene / medical-PVC band applied tool-free in < 3 seconds — 8 / 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 / 22 / 24 / 27 mm inside diameters per AOU / ABA / USGS BBL avian-banding standard; 35-45 mm velcro / ratchet variants for dairy cow pastern + sheep fetlock; ICAR Section 5.7 / USDA NPIP 9 CFR 146 retention-tested, UV-stabilised to ASTM G154 QUV 3,000 h, cold-cracking -40 °C per ASTM D2137, resistant to Virkon S / Oxoxide / chlorhexidine / iodine / quaternary-ammonium hatchery disinfection + EU 852/2004 / 853/2004 / 183/2005 feed-hygiene + AUTEC / Ecolab teat-dip for dairy, and survives 5-7 year breeder-flock lifespan / pigeon-racing career / dairy-parlor milking lifetime deployment.

brief.label: Chip options
brief.text: LF (134.2 kHz) ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B — USDA NPIP + EU 2019/2035 + USBGA / PIPA / FCI pigeon-racing + ICAR Section 5 dairy regulatory baseline, supplied via EM Microelectronic EM4305 / EM4469 / EM4569 or Sokymat / Hitag-S; LF ISO 11784/11785 HDX — Texas Instruments (TIRIS) / Destron Fearing / Allflex half-duplex variant for wet / hatchery / dairy-parlor EMI environments; UHF RAIN Gen2v2 — Impinj Monza R6-P / M750 / M770 / M775 for long-range layer-barn / broiler-breeder / dairy-parlor portals, NXP UCODE 9 / 9xe for extended user-memory carrying hatch-date / breed-code / genomic-parentage / owner-ID / vaccination history on the tag for disconnected reads at remote pigeon-racing liberation points or CITES-export quarantine, Alien Higgs-9 for densely-populated layer-cage clusters; dual-frequency LF + UHF (EM Microelectronic EM4423 or stacked LF + UHF inlay) for combined regulatory-LF + operational-UHF Tier-1 programmes; NTAG424 DNA (13.56 MHz HF) with SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature per NXP AN12196 for CITES Appendix I psittacines (African Grey / Amazon / Macaw / Cockatoo), CITES Appendix I/II raptors (Peregrine / Gyrfalcon / Saker / Harris Hawk / Goshawk), pedigree pigeon royal lofts / International Classic races ($1M prize pool), Wagyu dairy-cross elite-cow progeny, and any programme where per-tap cryptographic signing against the national-animal-ID / CITES register / pigeon-racing federation is required.

brief.label: Frequency / air interface
brief.text: 134.2 kHz LF per ISO 11784:1996 + ISO 11785:1996 + ISO 24631-1 to 24631-7:2017 conformance / performance / consistency testing for USDA NPIP + USBGA / PIPA / FCI pigeon-racing + ICAR Section 5 dairy leg-band regulatory read; 860-960 MHz UHF Gen2v2 per EPCglobal Class 1 Gen 2 v2.1 + ISO/IEC 18000-63:2015 for layer-barn / broiler-breeder / dairy-parlor / sort-gate / bulk-tank-pickup portal reads; 13.56 MHz HF per ISO/IEC 14443-3 Type A + NFC Forum Type 4 Tag Operation v3.0 for NTAG424 DNA CITES-psittacine / CITES-raptor / pedigree-pigeon per-bird forensic tap; FCC Part 15 / ETSI EN 300 330 (LF) + ETSI EN 302 208 (UHF) / IC RSS-210 + RSS-247 spectrum compliance; weather-sealed IP67 portal enclosures for outdoor hatchery / breeder-barn / pigeon-loft / dairy-parlor deployment.

brief.label: Bird / cow identifier scheme
brief.text: Per-bird / per-cow ISO 11784 15-digit national-animal-ID scheme carrying ICAR manufacturer code (3 digits), country code (3 digits per ISO 3166 numeric), species code (1 digit: 8=bird, 2=cattle, 1=sheep, 3=goat, 9=other) and unique-ID (9 digits), with upper-layer binding to USDA NPIP participant ID + flock number + hatchery code (per 9 CFR 146.10), USFWS BBL band number (9-digit federal band), USBGA / PIPA / FCI pigeon-racing club-band serial (country + club + year + sequence), CITES Appendix I/II specimen number + USDA Form 3-177 declaration, ICAR-audited manufacturer, dairy DHIA cow-number + herd-number. UHF layer publishes a parallel GS1 GIAI-96 per GS1 Tag Data Standard 2.0 §7.1 carrying hatch-date (YYYY-MM-DD) / calving-date, breed-code (Aviagen Ross / Cobb 500 / Hy-Line Brown / Lohmann / Novogen / ISA Brown / Shaver / Hubbard / Marans / Araucana / Orpington for poultry; HOL / JER / AYR / GUE / BSW / MIL for dairy), sire-dam band / DHIA number, owner participant-ID, management group (breeder / grow-out / layer / broiler / turkey / waterfowl / pigeon / falcon / psittacine; heifer / fresh-cow / mid-lac / dry-cow for dairy), vaccination lot (Marek / IBDV / NDV / ILT / AIV H5/H7 / IBV / MG / SE for poultry; RB51 / BVD / IBR / Clostridium for dairy), treatment history with withdrawal-period per FDA 21 CFR 556 + EMA CVMP MRL + EU 470/2009, body condition / egg-production / milk-yield metrics, genomic-parentage SNP panel ID (Aviagen Matrix / Cobb Genesis / Hendrix Genetics; Zoetis GeneSeek GGP / Neogen Igenity for dairy), and USDA NPIP clean-flock status + USFWS BBL + CITES Management Authority permit + pigeon-racing federation liberation + DHIA test-day record. Events publish as EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents with bizStep=banding / vaccinating / treating / hatching / calving / lay-housing / shipping / slaughtering / liberating / clocking / milking / drying-off / retiring with disposition keyed to custody state (on-premises / in-transit / in-breeder-barn / in-slaughter / in-race / in-lactation / in-dry-off / deceased / recalled / retired).

brief.label: Form-factor SKUs (6)
brief.text: (1) Snap-on TPU poultry leg band 8-14 mm ID × 8-12 mm width: laser-printed visual ID + LF 134.2 kHz FDX-B inlay for layer hens / broiler breeders / turkeys / game birds / Bantams; (2) Snap-on TPU raptor / psittacine CITES band 10-18 mm ID: tamper-evident one-way closure per CITES Appendix I/II Supplementary Identification Requirements + USFWS 50 CFR §21.23; (3) Pigeon-racing leg band 8-10 mm ID: USBGA / PIPA / FCI federation-band serial + LF inlay for automatic clocking at loft-trap electronic clocks (Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon); (4) Dual-frequency LF + UHF layer-cage flock band 14-18 mm ID: stacked inlay for combined NPIP regulatory + walk-through-antenna operational read; (5) Dairy cow pastern band 35-45 mm inner diameter velcro / ratchet: LF ISO 11784 FDX-B inlay for parlor-antenna cow-ID at DeLaval / BouMatic / Lely / GEA / AfiFarm milking station; (6) Sheep / goat fetlock band 25-35 mm: ICAR Section 10.8 fetlock-band variant for extensive-grazing operations where ear-tag retention is marginal.

brief.label: Housing material & retention qualification
brief.text: TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane 92A-95A Shore hardness) or medical-PVC or Santoprene TPV for primary band body — UV-stabilised to ASTM G154 QUV 3,000 h; cold-cracking -40 °C per ASTM D2137 for outdoor-flock / free-range / pigeon-loft / Patagonian-dairy deployment; tear strength > 90 N per ASTM D624 Die C; tensile > 30 MPa per ASTM D412; UL 94 HB; RoHS + REACH compliant; ICAR Section 5.7 (cattle fetlock) + USDA NPIP 9 CFR 146 + USFWS 50 CFR §21.23 banding-standard retention; Virkon S / Oxoxide / chlorhexidine / iodine / quaternary-ammonium / peracetic-acid hatchery-disinfection compatible; Ecolab / AUTEC / Diversey teat-dip compatible for dairy; snap-closure / velcro / ratchet tool-free application in < 3 seconds; laser-printed visual-ID number on outer face; EID chip potted in epoxy / polyurethane cavity resistant to layer-cage wire abrasion + pigeon-loft-perch wear + dairy parlor robotic-arm contact.

brief.label: Environmental qualification
brief.text: IP67 + IP68 band housing; -40 °C to +80 °C operating; -50 °C to +85 °C storage; UV exposure ASTM G154 QUV 3,000 h; salt-spray ASTM B117 1,000 h for coastal pigeon-loft / waterfowl-pond / dairy-parlor wash-down; chemical resistance to Virkon S / Oxoxide / Peracetic Acid / Chlorhexidine / Iodine / Quaternary Ammonium / Ecolab / AUTEC hatchery and parlor disinfectants; resistant to layer-house ammonia, broiler-barn dust, pigeon-loft droppings, dairy-parlor urine / manure / teat-dip / iodine / hoof-bath formaldehyde; ICAR Section 5.7 cattle-fetlock + Section 10.8 sheep-fetlock retention testing; USDA NPIP 9 CFR 146 compliance; USFWS 50 CFR §21.23 migratory-bird banding standard; CITES Appendix I/II supplementary-identification-requirements one-way-closure tamper-evidence; ISO 24631-5 consistency testing passed.

brief.label: Read range (barn / parlor / loft)
brief.text: LF (134.2 kHz) 5-20 cm from Allflex AWR250 / Biomark HPR Plus / Destron handheld + panel reader at layer-cage aisle + broiler-breeder walk / dairy milking-parlor antenna; UHF (860-960 MHz) 2-6 m from Zebra FX9600 / FX7500 fixed reader + Chainway C72 handheld (shorter than cattle ear-tag due to smaller antenna footprint on leg-band form factor); pigeon-racing Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon clock reads at 2-10 cm loft-trap range; HF NTAG424 DNA read range 2-5 cm per ISO/IEC 14443-3 Type A for CITES forensic per-bird tap; portal read-rate 95-98 % at layer-barn walk-through (UHF limited by dense layer-cage metal). Dairy-parlor milking-station antenna reads pastern-band at 5-15 cm as the cow steps onto the milking platform.

brief.label: Cryptographic posture
brief.text: For USDA NPIP + EU 2019/2035 + USBGA / PIPA / FCI pigeon-racing + USFWS BBL + ICAR Section 5 dairy regulatory baseline: ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B / HDX — unique-read-only 15-digit national-animal-ID with manufacturer authorisation via ICAR device-registration. For UHF operational layer: NXP UCODE 9 / 9xe user-memory permalock + password-protected access + TID serialisation; Impinj Monza R6-P 96-bit EPC + 32-bit TID access-password; Alien Higgs-9 128-bit user-memory kill-password. For Tier-1 CITES Appendix I psittacine / CITES Appendix I raptor / pedigree-pigeon International Classic / elite dairy-genomic-bull programmes: NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature per NXP AN12196 with the CITES Management Authority register / USBGA / PIPA / FCI federation register / ICAR Interbull genetic-register as cryptographic anchor — every CITES-Management-Authority tap, pigeon-clocking liberation-and-return event, dairy veterinary-chute tap, and slaughter-plant kill-floor event produces a tamper-evident signed record that survives EU 2017/625 Official Controls Regulation + USDA FSIS 9 CFR 381 poultry inspection + USDA AMS 7 CFR 56 shell-egg + CITES Trade Database audit.

brief.label: Scheme & herd-management integrations
brief.text: USDA APHIS NPIP (National Poultry Improvement Plan) Information System + USDA AMS LPS + USDA FSIS PHIS + USFWS Bird Banding Laboratory (BBL) / patuxent.usgs.gov; CITES Trade Database + Management Authority permit system (US Fish & Wildlife Service Office of Management Authority); USBGA (United States Band Group Association) + PIPA (Pigeon Insider Performance Awards) + FCI (Fédération Colombophile Internationale) + RPRA (Royal Pigeon Racing Association UK) + NPA (National Pigeon Association) + AU (American Racing Pigeon Union); Pigeon-racing clocks: Unikon, Benzing G2, Tauris, Bricon, MegaSpeed, Motz, Atis; ICAR Interbull genetic-evaluation; dairy: DairyComp 305, DeLaval DelPro, GEA CowScout, BouMatic MPC, Lely Horizon, AfiFarm, NEDAP CowControl, Moocall HEAT, Zoetis SMARTBOW, Allflex SenseHub, DHIA + NDHIA test-day data; poultry: Hy-Line 5i, Aviagen RMS, Cobb MX, Agri Stats, Lohmann LSL, Hendrix Nutreco, Cargill NutriSys, Hatchtech, Hatchery Planner, ErgoAdvantage; CITES: UNEP-WCMC Checklist of CITES Species + SPECIES+ + TRAFFIC database; EU: TRACES NT + ADIS + EFSA databases.

brief.label: Deployment cadence
brief.text: Week 1-2: USDA NPIP participant-ID + flock-number + hatchery-code registration; USFWS BBL federal-banding authorisation (if wild / migratory); CITES Management Authority permit application (Appendix I/II species); USBGA / PIPA / FCI / RPRA / AU club-affiliation for pigeon-racing; ICAR-approved supplier tag-order with device-register lookup; hatchery / loft / dairy-parlor as-built survey + applicator-tool inventory. Week 3-4: per-SKU + chip + housing-grade + retention-class + size-fit (8-14 mm poultry, 10-18 mm raptor, 8-10 mm pigeon, 14-18 mm layer, 35-45 mm dairy-pastern, 25-35 mm sheep-goat-fetlock) + applicator-jaw compatibility + genomic-parentage kit qualification; ASTM G154 QUV + D2137 cold-crack + B117 salt-spray + chemical-resistance validation. Week 5-10: pilot flock / loft / parlor rollout + LF handheld reader + UHF portal reader + pigeon-loft electronic-clock (Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon) wiring + dairy milking-parlor antenna integration + Hy-Line 5i / Aviagen RMS / Cobb MX / DairyComp 305 / DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / NEDAP CowControl / AfiFarm integration + baseline egg-production / ADG / milk-yield / race-velocity pilot data capture. Month 3+: enterprise rollout + USDA NPIP + USFWS BBL + CITES Trade Database + pigeon-racing federation data-submission batch automation + slaughter FSIS PHIS + EU 2017/625 OCR data-bridge + DHIA test-day submission + Tier-1 NTAG424 DNA rollout for CITES Appendix I / Royal Pigeon / elite-dairy-bull programmes.

sections.title: Regulatory & interoperability baseline at a glance
bullets: USDA NPIP 9 CFR Parts 145-147 + EU 2019/2035 + CITES Appendix I/II programmes presume 15-digit ISO 11784 FDX-B / HDX compliance for poultry breeder + CITES-listed psittacine + CITES-listed raptor identification — hand-closed aluminium breeder bands satisfy USDA NPIP visual baseline but do not meet export-certificate electronic-ID requirements for EU + Japan + Korea + China poultry-breeding-stock shipments.

ICAR Section 5.7 (cattle fetlock) + Section 10.8 (sheep-goat fetlock) testing is the international-trade interoperability gate for dairy + sheep-goat leg-band form factors — Allflex / Destron Fearing / Biomark / Datamars approved-supplier band stock carries ICAR device-register IDs that regulators cross-check under OIE WOAH + EU TRACES NT + USDA APHIS ADT.

USBGA / PIPA / FCI / RPRA / AU pigeon-racing federations increasingly accept ISO 11784 FDX-B electronic bands alongside traditional aluminium seamless bands — electronic clocking at the loft-trap (Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon) replaces manual clock-pad punching and eliminates clocking fraud that plagues amateur-to-international-class racing.

CITES Appendix I psittacines (African Grey, Hyacinth Macaw, Military Macaw, Cockatoos) + CITES Appendix I raptors (Peregrine, Gyrfalcon, Saker, Harpy Eagle) require CITES Supplementary Identification Requirements — the DEEP band layers NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC over the ISO 11784 baseline so every CITES Management Authority tap produces a cryptographically signed EPCIS 2.0 record that survives Trade Database + TRAFFIC cross-check.

Dairy-parlor leg-band deployments (DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / AfiFarm / NEDAP CowControl) use the LF pastern-band as the cow-ID anchor because cattle-ear-tag RFID struggles at milking-station head-position — the pastern is always presented to the parlor-floor antenna at consistent range regardless of cow stance.

sections.title: Hand-closed aluminium band + paper breeding-book + manual clock-pad vs DEEP dual-frequency leg-band EID
bullets: The before-state uses hand-closed aluminium seamless bands with die-stamped serial numbers + paper breeding-book records + manual clock-pad punching. It fails the moment a USDA APHIS NPIP export audit asks for clean-flock status binding to individual breeder hen + vaccination lot — or a CITES Management Authority requests photographic proof-of-identity for a registered Hyacinth Macaw — or a pigeon-racing club teller cannot verify which bird returned first in a 500-member international classic with $1M prize pool.

The after-state binds LF ISO 11784 FDX-B (regulatory) + UHF GS1 GIAI-96 (operational) + optional NTAG424 DNA (cryptographic) to a single snap-on leg-band that applies tool-free in under 3 seconds. Every bird / cow carries its own hatch-date / calving-date, USDA NPIP flock number, USFWS BBL band number, CITES Management Authority permit, USBGA / PIPA / FCI pigeon-racing serial, genomic-parentage SNP, vaccination lot, treatment history, and EPCIS 2.0 event trail.

In practice, integrators pair the DEEP band with Hy-Line 5i / Aviagen RMS / Cobb MX (poultry) + DairyComp 305 / DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / NEDAP CowControl / AfiFarm (dairy) + Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon (pigeon-racing) so every hatchery candling, vaccination pass, layer-barn walk-through, broiler-breeder transfer, dairy-parlor milking, CITES-management inspection, and pigeon-race liberation lands in the same event log as USDA NPIP Information System + USFWS BBL + CITES Trade Database + DHIA test-day submissions.

The dairy pastern-band + sheep-goat fetlock-band variants extend the same ISO 11784 EID scheme from poultry to the mammalian side of the farm, giving integrators a single leg-band SKU family that covers layer hens, broiler breeders, turkeys, pigeons, raptors, psittacines, dairy cows, and sheep / goats — with common LF handheld readers + UHF portals + NTAG424 DNA tap stations across all species.

sections.title: How buyers run poultry breeder / dairy / pigeon-racing / CITES programmes — operating notes
bullets: Tier-1 broiler-breeder operations — Aviagen Ross / Cobb 500 / Hubbard / Hendrix Genetics grandparent + parent-stock farms running 50,000-200,000 birds per site fit every breeder hen at photo-stimulation with LF FDX-B + UHF stacked leg-band; LF handheld at vaccination walk-through + UHF portal at egg-collection-room + transfer-to-slaughter weighs captures 95-98 % flock-reads vs 60-70 % with visual-band-only.

Layer-cage / cage-free / pastured-layer operations — Hy-Line / Lohmann / ISA / Novogen / Shaver / Nick Chick commercial layer flocks of 100,000-500,000 hens per complex use UHF portal reads at nest-box entries + feed-trough walks for individual egg-production + feed-intake + mortality recording; LF handheld for NPIP salmonella-environmental + AIV-surveillance individual-bird draw.

Pigeon-racing international-classic + national lofts — South African Million Dollar Pigeon Race + Algarve Great Derby + Dubai Pigeon Challenge + Chinese Iron Eagle Classic-level races use electronic banding at training basket + liberation point + loft-trap clock (Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon); the NTAG424 DNA layer prevents identity-swap fraud where a non-raced bird is substituted at the loft-trap for a faster bird clocked elsewhere.

Dairy milking-parlor cow-ID — DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / AfiFarm / NEDAP CowControl use LF pastern-band as primary cow-ID because rotary-parlor / parallel-parlor / robotic-milker head-position varies per cow stance while the pastern is always presented to the parlor-floor antenna; dairy farms running 500-5,000 cow herds get reliable 98-99 % per-milking individual-cow identification with conductivity / flow-rate / kick-off / rumination / heat-detection recording.

CITES Appendix I/II psittacine + raptor breeding — AKC-registered parrot aviary + peregrine-falcon + saker-falcon + Harris-hawk + Gyrfalcon breeding programmes layer NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 over the ISO 11784 baseline so every CITES Management Authority permit inspection, Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital visit, or border-crossing customs check produces a cryptographically signed EPCIS 2.0 record that survives CITES Trade Database + TRAFFIC cross-check + EU CITES Enforcement Office audit.

Sheep + goat ICAR Section 10.8 fetlock-band deployment — extensive-grazing sheep / goat operations where ear-tag retention is marginal (Merinos with small ears, Boer goats that tear tags on fencing, rangeland rodeo-type animals) fit a fetlock-band as a backup to the ear-tag EID; both carry the same ISO 11784 15-digit number so the regulatory read experience is identical.

Magnitudes vary with flock size, species, production system, regulatory jurisdiction, and genomic-testing depth; the DEEP record replaces hand-closed aluminium band + paper breeding-book + manual clock-pad with an ICAR-audited snap-on EID tied to USDA NPIP Information System / USFWS BBL / CITES Trade Database / DairyComp / DeLaval / GEA / BouMatic / Lely / NEDAP / Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon traceable records.

faq.question: Which band size fits my bird species or dairy cow?
faq.answer: Poultry tarsus-diameter sizing: 8-10 mm for finches / canaries / small songbirds, 8 mm for racing pigeons (USBGA standard), 12-14 mm for Bantams / quail / game birds, 16-18 mm for standard chickens + small ducks, 20-22 mm for large chickens + Muscovy ducks + small geese, 24-27 mm for turkeys + large geese + ratites. Raptor tarsus sizing follows USFWS 50 CFR §21.23 guidance: 10 mm Kestrel, 12 mm Merlin / Peregrine, 14 mm Goshawk / Harris Hawk, 18 mm Gyrfalcon / Saker / Golden Eagle. Dairy cow pastern-circumference: 35 mm for small-frame Jersey, 40 mm standard Holstein-Jersey, 45 mm large-frame Holstein + Brown Swiss. Sheep / goat fetlock: 25-30 mm small-frame wool-sheep + dairy-goat, 30-35 mm large-frame meat-sheep + Boer-goat. We provide sizing gauges + free sample bands for fitting tests before bulk ordering.

faq.question: Is the LF band compatible with USDA NPIP, CITES, USBGA pigeon racing, and ICAR dairy leg-band programmes?
faq.answer: Yes — all Proud Tek LF leg-band variants carry ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B or HDX 134.2 kHz transponders supplied from ICAR-approved manufacturers with registered device-register IDs. USDA NPIP 9 CFR 145-147 accepts electronic-ID for breeder + commercial poultry; CITES Appendix I/II supplementary-identification-requirements accept electronic-ID for psittacines + raptors (with one-way tamper-evident closure); USFWS 50 CFR §21.23 accepts electronic-ID for federally-banded birds; USBGA / PIPA / FCI / RPRA / AU pigeon-racing federations accept electronic-ID at loft-trap electronic clocks (Unikon / Benzing / Tauris / Bricon); ICAR Section 5.7 cattle-fetlock + Section 10.8 sheep-goat-fetlock accept the pastern / fetlock band form factor for dairy parlor + sheep-goat extensive-grazing deployments. Bands are supplied pre-programmed with USDA 840-series, USFWS federal band, CITES permit number, USBGA / PIPA / FCI serial, or ICAR-country-code numbering per your programme.

faq.question: When does NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 layering over the ISO 11784 baseline make sense?
faq.answer: For Tier-1 CITES Appendix I psittacines (African Grey, Hyacinth Macaw, Military Macaw, Cockatoos, Kakapo), CITES Appendix I/II raptors (Peregrine, Gyrfalcon, Saker, Harris Hawk, Harpy Eagle), pedigree pigeons in International Classic races with $100K-$1M prize pools, elite dairy-genomic-bull progeny at semen-collection stations, and any programme where a regulator, buyer, or race-steward needs cryptographic proof of identity at the point of tap. The NTAG424 DNA chip generates a per-tap CMAC-over-AES-128 signature per NXP AN12196 that anchors against the CITES Management Authority register, USBGA / PIPA / FCI federation register, or ICAR Interbull genetic register — a counterfeiter cannot replay a previous tap, clone the chip, or substitute an identically-banded bird / cow without detection. For commodity layer / broiler / dairy operations, the ISO 11784 FDX-B baseline plus UHF GS1 GIAI-96 operational layer is typically sufficient without NTAG424 DNA.

faq.question: How does the band interact with Virkon S / peracetic-acid hatchery disinfection and Ecolab teat-dip?
faq.answer: The TPU / Santoprene / medical-PVC housing is resistant to Virkon S (potassium peroxymonosulfate + sodium chloride), Oxoxide (chlorine dioxide), peracetic acid, chlorhexidine, iodine, and quaternary-ammonium hatchery disinfection chemistries at recommended-use dilutions. Ecolab / AUTEC / Diversey teat-dip (iodine / chlorhexidine / lactic acid / chlorine dioxide / glycerin-based) is tolerated by TPU pastern-band for dairy-parlor deployment. Formaldehyde hoof-bath at 4 % concentration for > 7 days continuous exposure can yellow the band but does not affect chip read performance. Laser-printed visual-ID numbers remain legible after 5+ years under ASTM G154 QUV UV exposure + hatchery disinfection + dairy-parlor wash-down chemistry.
